plugins.description: 9 Claude Code skills that run the sales block of a GTM system for B2B service companies: meeting prep, cold-call scripts, value proposition, offer ladder, branded proposals, pipeline analysis, deal qualification (SCOPE), the buyer-facing delivery process and a slide deck builder.
